reviews_captured_by_me.text: Justin was great to work with. He is very knowledgeable and helped us along the way with all the decisions. Stayed on budget and in the provided timeline. Our new shower looks great and we couldn’t be happier.

What an absolutely incredible job Justin did with our living/dining room tile. We chose a tile that looks like wood and he helped to compliment the existing tile with this updated pattern. The house was kept clean during the 5 day long job and we couldn’t be happier with the finished job.  We will recommend him to others and definitely use again for our next tile project.

Justin came highly recommended from our realtor in Lake Arrowhead. We hired JMR Tile and Stone for a full bathroom remodel and are absolutely thrilled with the results. The quality of work and communication were both excellent throughout the entire process. Justin often checked in with us informing us of any updates and changes with clear communication and was able to stay within our budget. We are beyond thankful we chose JMR!
